pitchEn: Echo Duel is a hunt in total darkness where the enemy gives itself away only by sound: a pulse of waves that quickly fades. Click the centre of the sound to strike — the more precise the click, the harder the hit — then dodge left or right to slip the counter-attack, and manage your distance on the vertical axis. Fight through 100 levels across 10 upgrade decades, each granting you a new tool while the enemy gains a new power. One-handed touch controls, fully offline, no accounts.
newFeaturesEn: First release of Echo Duel: a canvas-2D + WebAudio audio-hunting game with 100 levels across 10 upgrade decades, precise click-to-strike, dodge-the-counter combat and distance management, one-handed touch controls, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No accounts, no network. Only the chosen interface language and local progress are stored on-device. Game sound is generated on-device with WebAudio; the microphone is never used.

reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. Turn the device sound on: each enemy reveals its position only with a fading sound pulse. Tap/click the centre of the sound to strike, press the left/right buttons right after to dodge the counter, and use up/down to change distance. Defeat the enemies to advance through the levels. No account, login, or internet connection is required.
